#!/bin/sh
set -eu

DEST=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'direct archive:/ "Electronic Archive" "Raw jobs archived as files"'
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: invalid CUPS backend invocation' >&2
    exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
case "$job_id" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
        printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: invalid CUPS job id' >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

safe_title=$(printf '%s' "$3" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | cut -c 1-100)
[ -n "$safe_title" ] || safe_title=job
final=$DEST/${job_id}-${safe_title}.raw
tmp=$(mktemp "$DEST/.archive-${job_id}.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [ "$#" -ge 6 ]; then
    /bin/cat -- "$6" > "$tmp"
else
    /bin/cat > "$tmp"
fi
chmod 0640 "$tmp"

if ln "$tmp" "$final" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    exit 0
fi

if [ -f "$final" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$final"; then
    exit 0
fi

printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive collision for CUPS job $job_id" >&2
exit 1
